note: residual = desktopSurface - webSurface per form, attributed to the phase that owns the form's dominant gap. targetSurface is the desktop surface, because parity means the operator can reach what the desktop offers. webSurface is attributed once per page: a page shared by several desktop forms is credited to the form with the largest declared surface, so residuals are not double counted. attributedPlusResidual exceeds the desktop total because a per-form residual is clamped at zero, so forms where the web exceeds the desktop add surplus; the residual is therefore conservative, which is the safe direction. P0, P1, P2, P4, P5 and P11 own no form: verification, suppression fixes, the shared sub-detail grid, settings, the recalculation kernel and certification all cut across forms, and their surface gain lands inside the phases listed here.
